selection_rule: Choose the mode that best proves the story beat. Do not show the tactical plate on every beat.

modes.purpose: Establish the hook and the match or player at stake.
modes.preferred_visual: owner-approved exact-context match still or player portrait from Asset Library
modes.composition: one dominant image, one brief Vietnamese headline, restrained channel mark
modes.fallback: typographic question on the template's editorial backdrop

modes.purpose: Show what happened in the exact passage being discussed.
modes.preferred_visual: owner-approved exact-context still or user-supplied rights-cleared clip
modes.composition: full-frame source media; one hand-placed focus marker and at most two movement annotations; source/date retained
modes.fallback: authored tactical plate, explicitly labeled as an illustrative diagram

modes.purpose: Explain a shape, run, pressing trigger, or passing option that match footage alone does not make legible.
modes.preferred_visual: authored pitch plate in the selected aspect ratio
modes.composition: one focal player or space, one primary vector, sparse secondary vectors, no looping ball motion

modes.purpose: Make one sourced comparison or statistic legible.
modes.preferred_visual: single comparison card with source and date
modes.composition: one finding, no decorative number cluster; omit the card if the claim has no verified source

modes.purpose: Return to Allen's bounded reading of the evidence.
modes.preferred_visual: approved host media when supplied; otherwise quiet branded close
modes.composition: one-sentence takeaway and fixed channel signature; no forced call to action

annotation_rules: Every annotation must be supported by the reviewed script and its evidence.
A discovery result is never automatically saved or used.
Do not imitate a broadcast score bug, club crest, or another channel's distinctive illustration package.
Keep narration subtitles off; add a short label only when it contributes information beyond the voice.
